meta.title: GymFlow — Gym management
meta.description: GymFlow is a gym management app for owners, front-desk staff, and trainers: members and check-ins, staff scheduling, and reporting.
meta.ogDescription: Members, check-ins, scheduling and analytics for modern gyms.

settings.subtitle: Plans, opening hours, kiosk devices and the team.
settings.demoGuardBody: Create plans, invite staff and edit hours freely. Revoking a kiosk token and changing passwords are blocked so the public demo keeps working, and a nightly job restores the seed.
